-- CashInService: server-side owner of cash-in / purchase feedback.
-- Sends display data only to clients; never changes cash.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local CashInConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("CashInConfig", 10))
local ForgeTelemetry = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry", 10))
local TutorialService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("TutorialService", 10))

local Cfg: any = CashInConfig

local FLASH_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 64)
local FLASH_TIME = 0.15

local function getOrCreateRemote(name: string): RemoteEvent
	local existing = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing and existing:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		return existing
	end
	local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = name
	remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	return remote
end

local CashInRemote = getOrCreateRemote(CashInConfig.CASHIN_REMOTE)
local PurchaseRemote = getOrCreateRemote(CashInConfig.PURCHASE_REMOTE)

local CashInService = {}

type CollectorInfo = {
	part: BasePart,
	baseColor: Color3,
	emitter: ParticleEmitter,
	tween: Tween?,
}

local collectors: { CollectorInfo } = {}
local sendLog: { [Player]: { number } } = {}

local function isFiniteNumber(v: any): boolean
	return type(v) == "number" and v == v and v ~= math.huge and v ~= -math.huge
end

local function pitchForTier(tier: number): number
	local fn = Cfg.pitchForTier
	if type(fn) == "function" then
		local ok, res = pcall(fn, tier)
		if ok and isFiniteNumber(res) then
			return res
		end
	end
	return math.clamp(1 + 0.12 * (tier - 1), 0.5, 2)
end

local function findCollector(pos: Vector3): CollectorInfo?
	local best: CollectorInfo? = nil
	local bestDist = 25
	for i = #collectors, 1, -1 do
		local info = collectors[i]
		if info.part.Parent == nil then
			table.remove(collectors, i)
		else
			local d = (info.part.Position - pos).Magnitude
			if d < bestDist then
				bestDist = d
				best = info
			end
		end
	end
	if best == nil and pos == Vector3.zero and #collectors > 0 then
		best = collectors[#collectors]
	end
	return best
end

local function flashCollector(info: CollectorInfo)
	local part = info.part
	if part.Parent == nil then
		return
	end
	if info.tween then
		info.tween:Cancel()
	end
	part.Color = FLASH_COLOR
	local tween = TweenService:Create(part, TweenInfo.new(FLASH_TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Color = info.baseColor,
	})
	info.tween = tween
	tween:Play()
	info.emitter:Emit(4)
end

local function allowSend(player: Player): boolean
	local maxPerSec: number = 8
	if isFiniteNumber(Cfg.MAX_POPUPS_PER_SECOND) and Cfg.MAX_POPUPS_PER_SECOND > 0 then
		maxPerSec = Cfg.MAX_POPUPS_PER_SECOND
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local log = sendLog[player]
	if not log then
		log = {}
		sendLog[player] = log
	end
	local kept: { number } = {}
	for _, ts in ipairs(log) do
		if now - ts < 1 then
			table.insert(kept, ts)
		end
	end
	if #kept >= maxPerSec then
		sendLog[player] = kept
		return false
	end
	table.insert(kept, now)
	sendLog[player] = kept
	return true
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
	sendLog[p] = nil
end)

function CashInService.decorateCollector(collectorPart: BasePart)
	if typeof(collectorPart) ~= "Instance" or not collectorPart:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end

	if not collectorPart:FindFirstChild("CashInLight") then
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Name = "CashInLight"
		light.Color = CashInConfig.LIGHT_COLOR
		light.Brightness = CashInConfig.LIGHT_BRIGHTNESS
		light.Range = CashInConfig.LIGHT_RANGE
		light.Parent = collectorPart
	end

	-- Particle emitter used for the per-collect sparkle.
	local emitter = collectorPart:FindFirstChild("CashInEmitter")
	if not (emitter and emitter:IsA("ParticleEmitter")) then
		local e = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		e.Name = "CashInEmitter"
		e.Rate = 0
		e.Enabled = false
		e.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.8)
		e.Speed = NumberRange.new(6, 12)
		e.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(60, 60)
		e.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -8, 0)
		e.Color = ColorSequence.new(FLASH_COLOR)
		e.LightEmission = 1
		e.Size = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
		})
		e.Parent = collectorPart
		emitter = e
	end

	-- Sound object on the collector (client plays the pitched cash-in sound).
	if not collectorPart:FindFirstChild("CashInSound") then
		local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
		snd.Name = "CashInSound"
		local id = Cfg.CASHIN_SOUND_ID
		if type(id) == "string" and id ~= "" then
			snd.SoundId = id
		elseif type(id) == "number" and id > 0 then
			snd.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)
		end
		snd.Volume = 0.5
		snd.Parent = collectorPart
	end

	table.insert(collectors, {
		part = collectorPart,
		baseColor = collectorPart.Color,
		emitter = emitter :: ParticleEmitter,
		tween = nil,
	})

	local ring = Instance.new("Part")
	ring.Name = "CashInRing"
	ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	-- Cylinder axis is X; rotate so the ring lies flat (axis pointing up).
	local diameter = math.max(collectorPart.Size.X, collectorPart.Size.Z) + 2
	ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, diameter, diameter)
	ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(collectorPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, collectorPart.Size.Y / 2 + 1.5, 0))
		* CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	ring.Anchored = true
	ring.CanCollide = false
	ring.CanQuery = false
	ring.CanTouch = false
	ring.CastShadow = false
	ring.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	ring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 64)
	ring.Parent = collectorPart.Parent or workspace
	CollectionService:AddTag(ring, CashInConfig.RING_TAG)

	collectorPart.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
		if parent == nil and ring.Parent then
			ring:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

function CashInService.cashIn(player: Player, amount: number, tier: number, collectorPosition: Vector3)
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then
		return
	end
	if player.Parent ~= Players then
		return
	end
	if not isFiniteNumber(amount) then
		return
	end
	local t = if isFiniteNumber(tier) then tier else 1
	local pos = if typeof(collectorPosition) == "Vector3" then collectorPosition else Vector3.zero

	-- Collector flash + sparkle on every collected cube (cheap, not throttled).
	local info = findCollector(pos)
	if info then
		flashCollector(info)
	end

	if allowSend(player) then
		CashInRemote:FireClient(player, amount, t, pos, pitchForTier(t))
		ForgeTelemetry.count("cashin_fx_sent", 1)
	end

	-- Tutorial: a cube's value was credited to its owner (TutorialService ignores repeats).
	local ok = pcall(function()
		TutorialService.notify(player, "cashed")
	end)
	if not ok then
		ForgeTelemetry.count("cashin_tutorial_notify_failed", 1)
	end
end

-- JuiceService: server side of the juice/polish pass.
-- Sets up lighting, the JuiceFx / JuiceAck remotes, and fires juice events to clients.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local GameAssets = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameAssets"))
local ForgeTelemetry = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry"))

local JuiceService = {}

local ACK_COOLDOWN = 5

local inited = false
local fxRemote: RemoteEvent? = nil
local ackRemote: RemoteEvent? = nil
local lastAck: { [Player]: number } = {}

local function ensureRemote(name: string): RemoteEvent
	local existing = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(name)
	if existing and existing:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		return existing
	end
	local r = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	r.Name = name
	r.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	return r
end

local function fire(player: Player, payload: { [string]: any })
	if not fxRemote or not player or player.Parent ~= Players then
		return
	end
	fxRemote:FireClient(player, payload)
	ForgeTelemetry.count("juice_events", 1)
end

local function toPart(inst: any): BasePart?
	if typeof(inst) ~= "Instance" then
		return nil
	end
	if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
		return inst
	end
	if inst:IsA("Model") then
		if inst.PrimaryPart then
			return inst.PrimaryPart
		end
		return inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	end
	return nil
end

function JuiceService.init()
	if inited then
		return
	end
	inited = true

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		GameAssets.styleLighting()
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[JuiceService] styleLighting failed: " .. tostring(err))
	end

	fxRemote = ensureRemote("JuiceFx")
	local ack = ensureRemote("JuiceAck")
	ackRemote = ack

	ack.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, payload: any)
		if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then
			return
		end
		if type(payload) ~= "table" or payload.kind ~= "income" then
			return
		end
		local now = os.clock()
		local last = lastAck[player]
		if last and now - last < ACK_COOLDOWN then
			return
		end
		lastAck[player] = now
		ForgeTelemetry.count("income_shown", 1)
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player)
		lastAck[player] = nil
	end)
end

-- upgrade: entry from Upgrades data. padPart: the pad touched. newDropperModel: the dropper
-- that was just unlocked (Model or BasePart) or nil.
function JuiceService.onPurchase(player: Player, upgrade: any, padPart: any, newDropperModel: any)
	if type(upgrade) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local dropperPart = toPart(newDropperModel)
	if dropperPart then
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			GameAssets.popIn(dropperPart)
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("[JuiceService] popIn failed: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end

	local name = tostring(upgrade.name or upgrade.id or "Upgrade")
	local pos: Vector3? = nil
	if typeof(padPart) == "Instance" and padPart:IsA("BasePart") then
		pos = padPart.Position
	end
	fire(player, { kind = "buy", name = name, pos = pos })

	local isOre = upgrade.ore or upgrade.oreTier or upgrade.isOre
	if isOre then
		local value = upgrade.oreValue or upgrade.value or 0
		fire(player, { kind = "ore", name = name, value = value })
	end
end

function JuiceService.onInsufficient(player: Player, upgrade: any, shortfall: number)
	if type(shortfall) ~= "number" or shortfall ~= shortfall then
		return
	end
	fire(player, { kind = "poor", need = math.max(0, math.ceil(shortfall)) })
end

function JuiceService.onRebirth(player: Player)
	fire(player, { kind = "rebirth" })
end

function JuiceService.pushGoal(player: Player, name: string?, cost: number?)
	if name == nil or cost == nil then
		fire(player, { kind = "goal" })
		return
	end
	fire(player, { kind = "goal", name = name, cost = cost })
end

return JuiceService
